slides.narration: Chapter 10: The Screening Tower. Every concept from the previous chapters — Fibonacci growth, the golden ratio, the carry rule, the Drishti bound — comes together in a single structure: the screening tower.

The tower grows by Fibonacci: stage one has one position, stage two has one, stage three has two, stage four has three, stage five has five, and stage six has eight. Stage six is where we live — our universe, with its eight tower positions giving rise to four spacetime dimensions.

The coupling constants of the three fundamental forces — electromagnetic, strong, and weak — are all the SAME underlying ratio, D, viewed through different numbers of screening layers. The electromagnetic force is screened through six stages. The strong force operates through the bridges only. The weak force through the shortest path. One tower, three readings.
